text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah... I made it. I finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm in... Tokyo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Wait,
stay on track! This isn't the time for
dawdling! Let's see... now
that I'm at the
airport, I have to...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me? Could you help me
please? I need some directions.

text_block_list.name: Airport Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! Where are you trying to
go?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to get to the Japan Umamusume
Training Center Academy,
please!
Event title logo display

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy: Japan's best training
institution for Umamusume
who aspire to
enter the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've always admired the Tracen Academy
racers. Ever since I was little,
I've watched
them light up the track on TV...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Each and every one of them was so special!
They really sparkled! I
always wanted to
be just like them!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(So I couldn't believe it when I passed
the school entrance exam. Mom and I had to
pinch each other to make sure we weren't

dreaming!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(But this is no dream. No,
I'm here to make
my dreams come true!
That's why... I have
to run!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm here!
This is the station closest to the
academy! Mom told me to
make sure to
ask someone for directions, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Nah! I have a map,
after all. I can just use
this and I'll be fine! After
all...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
From today on, I'm a student of Tracen
Academy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...A student with no sense of direction!
Dummy, dummy, dummy,
dummyyy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Where in blazes am I?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh... The sun's getting low... and I'm
hungry too. Am I on a
one-way road to
disaster? Mooooom!
Whoosh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was that the wind?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (Not a chance! That was totally...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Those ears, that tail... They're just like
mine!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whooooa! No way, omigosh! You're
actually, like really, actually...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...an Umamusume, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? I-I am, but... do you need
something?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No! I mean,
this is just my first time seeing
one in person like this!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (Whoaaa, like... Whoa! This is crazy! She's an Umamusume like me, yet so different! Her tail sparkling in the setting sun is so prettyyy!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ummm...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! S-s-sorry! I didn't mean to stare at
you like that! I was just so
amazed with
how pretty you are... Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, now that I take a closer look,
that red
tracksuit of yours... Does
that mean you're
a student at Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes... And your uniform means... you're
one too, no?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I just transferred here today though!
I'm Special Week! Nice to
meet you!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? ...Um,
nice to meet you too.
I'm Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, huh? I won't forget! Anyway, um...
is it okay if I ask you
something?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The Academy! Do you know how to get
there?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Phew. Special Week, um... are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Wheeze... Wheeew... I-I'm okay! I mean, I'm better than okay!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That was a lot of fun! Like, sooooo much
fun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've never run together with anyone
before, let alone another
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The tippy tap of our footsteps and our
tails swishing around
together... Hahaha! It
was so great, you know? Like, seriously
fun!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You think so?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... By the way... we're here. This is
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?! It's here?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Moving...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: This is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Moving...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Moving...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's sooo huuuge... Ueeergh...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Aah?! Uh... Special Week?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(And so the curtain rises on my new
life at
Tracen Academy!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Special Week?! Um... Please, w-wake
up!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (...Though I can't even rise to my feet!)
